verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Copilot has a memory feature that stores user-requested facts and uses them to personalize future responses/suggestions (docs-32, docs-33), which supports persistent context, but there's no evidence of an explicit 'custom instructions' or persona-setting panel that shapes every response, and no independent corroboration of how consistently memory is applied. missing for 10: explicit custom-instructions/persona settings UI, evidence of consistent application across all responses, independent/hands-on confirmation of memory reliability.
